reasoning: For a fixed purchase order, collecting all required token pairs first is feasible, so the number of collection turns is the maximum of total red and blue expenditures. Track discounts instead of potentially huge costs: each purchased card saves at most the number of earlier same-color cards. For each subset and exact red discount keep the largest blue discount, since smaller blue discounts at the same state are dominated. Transitions depend only on the subset color counts and next card, and the final objective adds n purchase turns. Thus the DP covers every order without restricting cost magnitudes.
